name: Honey

iAs.rationale: No sovereign inorganic-arsenic ML exists for honey; total arsenic is governed (300 ug/kg, MERCOSUR/Paraguay). Inorganic arsenic is the toxic species and is obtained by reflex speciation when total arsenic is elevated.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; reflex iAs speciation (HPLC-ICP-MS) on any total-As exceedance.

MeHg.rationale: Methylmercury forms by aquatic microbial methylation and bioaccumulates in fish; honey has no methylation pathway and no mercury source. Total mercury is governed (50 ug/kg, Vietnam).

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for honey and no concentration pathway operates: honey is a nectar sugar with trace mineral content, not a nickel accumulator or a hydrogenated/mineral-concentrated product. Rebuttable and audited against the register each build.

Cr.rationale: No sovereign total-chromium ML exists for honey; the only food chromium MLs in the register are dairy. No chromium concentration pathway operates in a nectar sugar. Rebuttable and audited each build.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any lot whose total-chromium screen exceeds the reflex trigger is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; honey is sold in glass or plastic, not tinplate. No non-canned tin pathway exists.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for honey and no aluminium uptake or migration pathway operates in a nectar sugar. Rebuttable and audited each build.

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default; face value, no reconstitution; read-across / control / not-material for unregulated cells; no occurrence percentiles)
lineage_note: Initial Cat-31 government-limit standard. Honey/sugar/syrup MLs (Israel FCS, MERCOSUR GMC 12/2011, Paraguay Decreto 1335, Vietnam QCVN 8-2, Singapore Food Regs) govern Pb/Cd/tAs/iAs/tHg at face value. Rice/grain syrup iAs is a disclosed read-across from the EU rice iAs ML (rice-derived). Molasses/rice-syrup nickel held under a mineral-concentration screen; Al/Sn/total-Cr not-material; Cr-VI reflex control; MeHg not-material.
